async fn folder_cascade_grant_exists(
        &self,
        subject_types: &[&str],
        subject_ids: &[Uuid],
        permission: Permission,
        folder_id: Uuid,
        counters: &QueryCounters,
    ) -> Result<bool, DomainError> {
        counters.sql_queries.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let roles = Self::roles_implying_strings(permission);
        let exists: Option<i32> = sqlx::query_scalar(
            r#"
            SELECT 1
              FROM storage.role_grants g
              JOIN storage.folders gf ON gf.id = g.resource_id
             WHERE g.subject_type  = ANY($1)
               AND g.subject_id    = ANY($2)
               AND g.role          = ANY($3::storage.grant_role[])
               AND g.resource_type = 'folder'
               AND (g.expires_at IS NULL OR g.expires_at > NOW())
               AND gf.lpath @> (SELECT lpath FROM storage.folders WHERE id = $4)
             LIMIT 1
            "#,
        )
        .bind(subject_types)
        .bind(subject_ids)
        .bind(&roles)
        .bind(folder_id)
        .fetch_optional(self.pool.as_ref())
        .await
        .map_err(|e| DomainError::internal_error("PgAcl", format!("folder cascade: {e}")))?;

        Ok(exists.is_some())
    }

namespace oxicloud_kernel.Properties

/-! ## The permission check (`PgAclEngine::check`) -/

/-- In storage-migration read-only mode only reads are allowed. -/
theorem migration_readonly_blocks_mutations (db : model.Db) (now : I64) (s : model.Subject)
    (p : model.Permission) (r : model.Resource) (hp : p ≠ .Read) :
    acl.check db true now s p r = ok false := by
  apply oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudMigrationReadonly.migration_readonly_blocks_mutations <;> assumption

/-- On a read-only drive, nothing inside it (nor the drive) can be changed. -/
theorem drive_read_only_blocks_mutations (db : model.Db) (ro : Bool) (now : I64) (s : model.Subject)
    (p : model.Permission) (r : model.Resource) (d : U64) (dr : model.Drive) (hp : p ≠ .Read)
    (hd : driveOf db r = some d) (hr : driveRow db d = some dr) (hro : dr.policies.read_only = true) :
    acl.check db ro now s p r ≠ ok true := by
  apply oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudDriveReadOnly.drive_read_only_blocks_mutations <;> assumption

/-- Expired grants play no part in a decision. -/
theorem expired_grants_ignored (db db' : model.Db) (ro : Bool) (now : I64) (s : model.Subject)
    (p : model.Permission) (r : model.Resource) (hs : SameButGrants db db')
    (hg : db'.grants.val = db.grants.val.filter (fun g => live g now)) :
    acl.check db' ro now s p r = acl.check db ro now s p r := by
  apply oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudExpiredGrants.expired_grants_ignored <;> assumption

/-- A link token is allowed only through a live grant to that token. -/
theorem token_needs_its_own_grant (db : model.Db) (ro : Bool) (now : I64) (t : U64)
    (p : model.Permission) (r : model.Resource) (h : acl.check db ro now (.Token t) p r = ok true) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.subject = .Token t ∧ Live g now := by
  apply oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudTokenGrant.token_needs_its_own_grant <;> assumption

/-- Share is granted only through a live Owner grant. -/
theorem share_needs_owner (db : model.Db) (ro : Bool) (now : I64) (s : model.Subject) (r : model.Resource)
    (h : acl.check db ro now s .Share r = ok true) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now := by
  apply oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudShareNeedsOwner.share_needs_owner <;> assumption

/-- The check always answers: group expansion and folder lookups terminate,
when the membership rows leave room for two more IDs. The expansion holds the
user, the internal group and every group it reaches; with `Usize.max - 1`
groups that is more IDs than a `Vec` holds, a table no database can store. -/
theorem check_total (db : model.Db) (ro : Bool) (now : I64) (s : model.Subject) (p : model.Permission)
    (r : model.Resource) (hm : db.memberships.length + 2 ≤ Usize.max) : ∃ b, acl.check db ro now s p r = ok b := by
  apply oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudCheckTotal.check_total <;> assumption

/-! ## The grant endpoints -/

/-- Creating a grant needs Share on the resource. -/
theorem create_needs_share (db db' : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller : U64) (r : model.Resource)
    (s : model.Subject) (role : model.Role) (e : Option I64) (rep : grantapi.Reply)
    (h : grantapi.transition db env caller (.CreateGrant r s role e) = ok (db', .Ok rep)) :
    acl.check db env.migration_readonly env.now (.User caller) .Share r = ok true := by
  apply oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudCreateNeedsShare.create_needs_share <;> assumption

/-- A grant created on a folder or file obeys its drive's sharing policies:
no sharing where it is forbidden, and no link token where public links are. -/
theorem create_respects_sharing_policies (db db' : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller : U64)
    (r : model.Resource) (s : model.Subject) (role : model.Role) (e : Option I64) (rep : grantapi.Reply)
    (d : U64) (dr : model.Drive) (hst : isStorage r = true) (hd : driveOf db r = some d)
    (hr : driveRow db d = some dr)
    (h : grantapi.transition db env caller (.CreateGrant r s role e) = ok (db', .Ok rep)) :
    dr.policies.forbid_sharing = false ∧ (∀ t, s = .Token t → dr.policies.forbid_public_links = false) := by
  apply oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudSharingPolicies.create_respects_sharing_policies <;> assumption

/-- A personal drive's membership cannot be changed by creating or setting
a role: the request fails and changes nothing. -/
theorem personal_drive_members_fixed (db db' : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller d : U64)
    (s : model.Subject) (role : model.Role) (e : Option I64) (req : grantapi.Request)
    (dr : model.Drive) (hr : driveRow db d = some dr) (hk : dr.kind = .Personal)
    (hq : req = .CreateGrant (.Drive d) s role e ∨ req = .SetRole (.Drive d) s role e)
    (out : core.result.Result grantapi.Reply model.ErrorKind)
    (h : grantapi.transition db env caller req = ok (db', out)) :
    db' = db ∧ ∃ err, out = .Err err := by
  apply oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudPersonalDrive.personal_drive_members_fixed <;> assumption

/-- Creating or setting a role never leaves a drive that had an owner
without one, in a database whose grants are unique per subject and resource
as the table's key makes them. -/
theorem drive_keeps_an_owner (db db' : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller d : U64) (s : model.Subject)
    (role : model.Role) (e : Option I64) (req : grantapi.Request) (rep : grantapi.Reply)
    (hq : req = .CreateGrant (.Drive d) s role e ∨ req = .SetRole (.Drive d) s role e)
    (hu : GrantsUnique db)
    (ho : 0 < ownerCount db d) (h : grantapi.transition db env caller req = ok (db', .Ok rep)) :
    0 < ownerCount db' d := by
  apply oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudKeepsOwner.drive_keeps_an_owner <;> assumption

    (r : model.Resource) (s : model.Subject) (role : model.Role) (e : Option I64) (req : grantapi.Request)

import OxicloudKernel
import H5iAppLib
/-!
# OxiCloud access control: the spec

From OxiCloud's code and documentation at 8c0dd33. Lookups read the tables
the way the engine's queries do: the first row with the id.
-/
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std oxicloud_kernel

namespace oxicloud_kernel

deriving instance DecidableEq for model.Resource, model.Role

end oxicloud_kernel

namespace oxicloud_kernel.Spec

/-- A grant counts at `now`: no expiry, or one still ahead. -/
def live (g : model.Grant) (now : I64) : Bool :=
  match g.expires_at with
  | none => true
  | some t => decide (now.val < t.val)

abbrev Live (g : model.Grant) (now : I64) : Prop := live g now = true

/-- The drive a folder or file lives in; a drive is its own. -/
def driveOf (db : model.Db) : model.Resource → Option U64
  | .Folder x => (db.folders.val.find? (·.id = x)).map (·.drive_id)
  | .File x => (db.files.val.find? (·.id = x)).map (·.drive_id)
  | .Drive x => some x
  | _ => none

def driveRow (db : model.Db) (d : U64) : Option model.Drive := db.drives.val.find? (·.id = d)

/-- Two databases that differ at most in their grants. -/
def SameButGrants (a b : model.Db) : Prop :=
  a.users = b.users ∧ a.memberships = b.memberships ∧ a.drives = b.drives ∧ a.folders = b.folders ∧ a.files = b.files

/-- At most one grant per subject and resource: `storage.role_grants`'s
`UNIQUE (subject_type, subject_id, resource_type, resource_id)`, which
upstream's `set_role` (`ON CONFLICT .. DO UPDATE`) relies on. -/
def GrantsUnique (db : model.Db) : Prop :=
  (db.grants.val.map (fun g => (g.subject, g.resource))).Nodup

/-- Owner grants on a drive, whatever their expiry. -/
def ownerCount (db : model.Db) (d : U64) : Nat :=
  (db.grants.val.filter (fun g => decide (g.resource = .Drive d ∧ g.role = .Owner))).length

def isStorage : model.Resource → Bool
  | .Folder _ | .File _ => true
  | _ => false

end oxicloud_kernel.Spec

import Spec
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std oxicloud_kernel

namespace oxicloud_kernel.SpecKernel

/-- The session role policy: anonymous visitors, ordinary users, administrators,
and server owners in increasing privilege order. -/
def RoleLevel : userrole.UserRole → Nat
  | .Anonymous => 0
  | .User => 1
  | .Admin => 2
  | .Owner => 3

/-- Canonical spellings accepted at the session boundary. -/
def RoleWire : userrole.UserRole → List U8
  | .Owner => [111#u8, 119#u8, 110#u8, 101#u8, 114#u8]
  | .Admin => [97#u8, 100#u8, 109#u8, 105#u8, 110#u8]
  | .User => [117#u8, 115#u8, 101#u8, 114#u8]
  | .Anonymous => [97#u8, 110#u8, 111#u8, 110#u8, 121#u8, 109#u8, 111#u8, 117#u8, 115#u8]

/-- A stored user row has one of the three named account roles. -/
def StoredRole (raw : List U8) (r : userrole.UserRole) : Prop :=
  raw = RoleWire r ∧ r ≠ .Anonymous

/-- A session may additionally represent an anonymous visitor. -/
def SessionRole (raw : List U8) (r : userrole.UserRole) : Prop := raw = RoleWire r

/-- A wire role satisfies a requirement only if its canonical spelling is
recognized and its privilege is sufficient. -/
def MeetsRole (raw : List U8) (min : userrole.UserRole) : Prop :=
  ∃ r, SessionRole raw r ∧ RoleLevel min ≤ RoleLevel r



/-- Canonical database discriminator for subjects. -/
def SubjectWire : model.Subject → List U8
  | .User _ => [117#u8, 115#u8, 101#u8, 114#u8]
  | .Group _ => [103#u8, 114#u8, 111#u8, 117#u8, 112#u8]
  | .Token _ => [116#u8, 111#u8, 107#u8, 101#u8, 110#u8]

/-- Identity in a subject namespace. -/
def SubjectId : model.Subject → U64
  | .User id => id
  | .Group id => id
  | .Token id => id

/-- Canonical database discriminator for resources. -/
def ResourceWire : model.Resource → List U8
  | .Folder _ => [102#u8, 111#u8, 108#u8, 100#u8, 101#u8, 114#u8]
  | .File _ => [102#u8, 105#u8, 108#u8, 101#u8]
  | .Drive _ => [100#u8, 114#u8, 105#u8, 118#u8, 101#u8]
  | .Calendar _ => [99#u8, 97#u8, 108#u8, 101#u8, 110#u8, 100#u8, 97#u8, 114#u8]
  | .AddressBook _ => [97#u8, 100#u8, 100#u8, 114#u8, 101#u8, 115#u8, 115#u8, 95#u8, 98#u8, 111#u8, 111#u8, 107#u8]
  | .Playlist _ => [112#u8, 108#u8, 97#u8, 121#u8, 108#u8, 105#u8, 115#u8, 116#u8]

/-- Identity in a resource namespace. -/
def ResourceId : model.Resource → U64
  | .Folder id => id
  | .File id => id
  | .Drive id => id
  | .Calendar id => id
  | .AddressBook id => id
  | .Playlist id => id

/-- Canonical database discriminator for permissions. -/
def PermissionWire : model.Permission → List U8
  | .Read => [114#u8, 101#u8, 97#u8, 100#u8]
  | .Create => [99#u8, 114#u8, 101#u8, 97#u8, 116#u8, 101#u8]
  | .Share => [115#u8, 104#u8, 97#u8, 114#u8, 101#u8]
  | .Comment => [99#u8, 111#u8, 109#u8, 109#u8, 101#u8, 110#u8, 116#u8]
  | .Delete => [100#u8, 101#u8, 108#u8, 101#u8, 116#u8, 101#u8]
  | .Update => [117#u8, 112#u8, 100#u8, 97#u8, 116#u8, 101#u8]
  | .Manage => [109#u8, 97#u8, 110#u8, 97#u8, 103#u8, 101#u8]

/-- Complete stable enumeration used by permission queries. -/
def PermissionOrder : List model.Permission := [.Read, .Create, .Share, .Comment, .Delete, .Update, .Manage]

/-- Canonical database discriminator for roles. -/
def GrantRoleWire : model.Role → List U8
  | .Viewer => [118#u8, 105#u8, 101#u8, 119#u8, 101#u8, 114#u8]
  | .Commenter => [99#u8, 111#u8, 109#u8, 109#u8, 101#u8, 110#u8, 116#u8, 101#u8, 114#u8]
  | .Contributor => [99#u8, 111#u8, 110#u8, 116#u8, 114#u8, 105#u8, 98#u8, 117#u8, 116#u8, 111#u8, 114#u8]
  | .Editor => [101#u8, 100#u8, 105#u8, 116#u8, 111#u8, 114#u8]
  | .Owner => [111#u8, 119#u8, 110#u8, 101#u8, 114#u8]

/-- Complete stable enumeration used by permission queries. -/
def RoleOrder : List model.Role := [.Viewer, .Commenter, .Contributor, .Editor, .Owner]


/-- A drive's explicit choices override its kind's defaults, including explicit
false choices. An absent expiry cap override inherits the default cap. -/
def PolicyResolved (d : drivepolicy.Policies) (o : drivepolicy.Overrides)
    (r : drivepolicy.Policies) : Prop :=
  r.forbid_sharing = o.forbid_sharing.getD d.forbid_sharing ∧
  r.forbid_external_sharing = o.forbid_external_sharing.getD d.forbid_external_sharing ∧
  r.forbid_public_links = o.forbid_public_links.getD d.forbid_public_links ∧
  r.forbid_cross_drive_move = o.forbid_cross_drive_move.getD d.forbid_cross_drive_move ∧
  r.forbid_owner_role_change = o.forbid_owner_role_change.getD d.forbid_owner_role_change ∧
  r.include_in_photo_index = o.include_in_photo_index.getD d.include_in_photo_index ∧
  r.include_in_music_index = o.include_in_music_index.getD d.include_in_music_index ∧
  r.read_only = o.read_only.getD d.read_only ∧
  r.require_public_link_password = o.require_public_link_password.getD d.require_public_link_password ∧
  r.max_public_link_days = o.max_public_link_days.or d.max_public_link_days

/-- Both the broad sharing policy and the link-specific policy permit minting. -/
def PublicLinksAllowed (p : drivepolicy.Policies) : Prop :=
  p.forbid_sharing = false ∧ p.forbid_public_links = false

def SharingAllowed (p : drivepolicy.Policies) : Prop := p.forbid_sharing = false

/-- Administrators may manage a locked owner roster. -/
def OwnerChangesAllowed (p : drivepolicy.Policies) (admin : Bool) : Prop :=
  p.forbid_owner_role_change = false ∨ admin = true

def CrossDriveMoveAllowed (p : drivepolicy.Policies) : Prop :=
  p.forbid_cross_drive_move = false

/-- Only external user principals are constrained by the external-sharing knob. -/
def ExternalSharingAllowed (p : drivepolicy.Policies) (s : model.Subject) (external : Bool) : Prop :=
  p.forbid_external_sharing = false ∨ (∀ id, s ≠ .User id) ∨ external = false

/-- A policy guard succeeds exactly when allowed and otherwise returns the
canonical unsupported-operation refusal. -/
def GuardDecision (allowed : Prop) (r : core.result.Result Unit model.ErrorKind) : Prop :=
  (r = .Ok () ↔ allowed) ∧ (r = .Err .OperationNotSupported ↔ ¬allowed)



/-- Canonical session origins retain the authentication mechanism across restoration. -/
def OriginWire : session.SessionOrigin → List U8
  | .Password => [112#u8, 97#u8, 115#u8, 115#u8, 119#u8, 111#u8, 114#u8, 100#u8]
  | .Opaque => [111#u8, 112#u8, 97#u8, 113#u8, 117#u8, 101#u8]
  | .MagicLink => [109#u8, 97#u8, 103#u8, 105#u8, 99#u8, 95#u8, 108#u8, 105#u8, 110#u8, 107#u8]
  | .Oidc => [111#u8, 105#u8, 100#u8, 99#u8]
  | .Device => [100#u8, 101#u8, 118#u8, 105#u8, 99#u8, 101#u8]
  | .Unknown => [117#u8, 110#u8, 107#u8, 110#u8, 111#u8, 119#u8, 110#u8]

/-- Known authentication origins are recognized exactly, with Unknown as the fallback. -/
def OriginDecoded (raw : List U8) (o : session.SessionOrigin) : Prop :=
  ∀ known, known ≠ .Unknown → (o = known ↔ raw = OriginWire known)

/-- Revocation changes no identity, credential, binding, or lifetime information. -/
def SessionRevoked (before after : session.Session) : Prop :=
  after.revoked = true ∧ { after with revoked := before.revoked } = before

/-- Binding only applies to an unbound session and changes no other security state. -/
def SessionBound (before : session.Session) (key : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (after : session.Session) : Prop :=
  before.dpop_jkt = none ∧ after.dpop_jkt = some key ∧
  { after with dpop_jkt := before.dpop_jkt } = before

/-- OIDC logout metadata changes cannot alter the principal, DPoP binding, or revocation. -/
def SessionTokenAttached (before : session.Session) (token : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (after : session.Session) : Prop :=
  after.oidc_id_token = some token ∧ { after with oidc_id_token := before.oidc_id_token } = before

def SessionSidAttached (before : session.Session) (sid : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (after : session.Session) : Prop :=
  after.oidc_sid = some sid ∧ { after with oidc_sid := before.oidc_sid } = before



/-- Storage selectors use a bounded ASCII alphabet suitable for environment and URL names. -/
def StorageByte (b : U8) : Prop :=
  (97 ≤ b.val ∧ b.val ≤ 122) ∨ (48 ≤ b.val ∧ b.val ≤ 57) ∨ b.val = 95 ∨ b.val = 45

def Base64UrlByte (b : U8) : Prop := StorageByte b ∨ (65 ≤ b.val ∧ b.val ≤ 90)

def ValidStorageName (raw : List U8) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ raw.length ∧ raw.length ≤ 32 ∧ ∀ b ∈ raw, StorageByte b

/-- A login thumbprint has the unpadded base64url shape of a SHA-256 digest. -/
def ValidJkt (raw : List U8) : Prop := raw.length = 43 ∧ ∀ b ∈ raw, Base64UrlByte b

def JktDecision (raw : List U8)
    (r : core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) validation.JktError) : Prop :=
  match r with
  | .Ok value => ValidJkt raw ∧ value.val = raw
  | .Err .WrongLength => raw.length ≠ 43
  | .Err .BadAlphabet => raw.length = 43 ∧ ¬ ∀ b ∈ raw, Base64UrlByte b

/-- Required verification admits only an explicit true claim; audit reasons distinguish
asserted false claims from absent claims and flag-disabled acceptance. -/
def VerifiedEmailDecision (claim : Option Bool) (required : Bool) (d : validation.EmailDecision) : Prop :=
  (d.reject = false ↔ (required = true → claim = some true)) ∧
  (d.reason = some .Unverified ↔ claim = some false ∧ required = true) ∧
  (d.reason = some .UnverifiedFlagOff ↔ claim = some false ∧ required = false) ∧
  (d.reason = some .ClaimAbsentRequired ↔ claim = none ∧ required = true) ∧
  (d.reason = none ↔ claim = some true ∨ (claim = none ∧ required = false))



/-- Password changes preserve the resource, creator, token, lifetime, and accounting state. -/
def SharePasswordChanged (before : share.Share) (hash : Option (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    (after : share.Share) : Prop :=
  after.password_hash = hash ∧ { after with password_hash := before.password_hash } = before

  GroupAlphanumeric b ∨ b.val = 46 ∨ b.val = 45 ∨ b.val = 95

  ∃ b, raw[0]? = some b ∧ GroupAlphanumeric b

  1 ≤ raw.length ∧ raw.length ≤ 64 ∧ GroupNameStart raw ∧ ∀ b ∈ raw, GroupNameByte b

def GroupNameDecision (raw : List U8)
    (r : core.result.Result Unit subjectgroup.NameError) : Prop :=

  | .Ok _ => ValidGroupName raw
  | .Err .Empty => raw.length = 0
  | .Err .TooLong => 1 ≤ raw.length ∧ 64 < raw.length
  | .Err .InvalidStart => 1 ≤ raw.length ∧ raw.length ≤ 64 ∧ ¬ GroupNameStart raw
  | .Err .InvalidCharacter => 1 ≤ raw.length ∧ raw.length ≤ 64 ∧

  match flags, out with
  | .Found f, .Active role => f.active = true ∧ role.val = RoleWire f.role
  | .Found f, .Revoked => f.active = false

  | .Unavailable, .Active role => role.val = claim

import SpecKernel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result oxicloud_kernel
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
namespace oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes

theorem push_ok {α} {v w : alloc.vec.Vec α} {x : α} (h : alloc.vec.Vec.push v x = ok w) :
    w.val = v.val ++ [x] := by
  unfold alloc.vec.Vec.push at h
  dsimp only at h
  split at h
  · simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at h; subst h; simp [alloc.vec.Vec.from_val]
  · simp at h

/-- Copying a wire spelling preserves every byte. -/
theorem copy_ok (a : Slice U8) (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : bytes.copy a = ok out) : out.val = a.val := by
  unfold bytes.copy bytes.copy_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x : alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Usize => x.1.val = a.val.take x.2.val)
    (fun out => out.val = a.val) (fun x => a.val.length - x.2.val) ?_
    _ out (by simp) h
  rintro ⟨v, i⟩ r hv hr
  unfold bytes.copy_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ := slice_index_ok hi2
    have hp := push_ok hout1
    have hj := add_ok_val hi3
    simp only at hv ⊢
    refine ⟨?_, by scalar_tac⟩
    rw [hp, hv, hj]
    simpa [he] using (List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hi).symm
  · simpa [List.take_of_length_le (by scalar_tac : a.val.length ≤ i.val)] using hv

theorem equal_loop_ok (a b : Slice U8) (hl : a.val.length = b.val.length)
    (i : Usize) (r : Bool) (hp : ∀ j < i.val, a.val[j]? = b.val[j]?)
    (h : bytes.equal_loop a b i = ok r) : (r = true ↔ a.val = b.val) := by
  unfold bytes.equal_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun i : Usize => ∀ j < i.val, a.val[j]? = b.val[j]?)
    (fun r => r = true ↔ a.val = b.val) (fun i => a.val.length - i.val) ?_ i r hp h
  intro x r hx hr
  unfold bytes.equal_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨ha, hea⟩ := slice_index_ok hi2
    obtain ⟨hb, heb⟩ := slice_index_ok hi3
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff]
    intro he
    have he' : i2 = i3 := by simpa [List.getElem?_eq_getElem ha, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hb, hea, heb] using congrArg (fun xs : List U8 => xs[x.val]?) he
    subst i3
    simp_all
  · obtain ⟨ha, hea⟩ := slice_index_ok hi2
    obtain ⟨hb, heb⟩ := slice_index_ok hi3
    have hj := add_ok_val hi4
    refine ⟨?_, by scalar_tac⟩
    intro j hji
    by_cases hjx : j < x.val
    · exact hx j hjx
    · have : j = x.val := by scalar_tac
      subst j
      have he : i2 = i3 := (u8_eq_iff _ _).2 (by simpa using hc_1)
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem ha, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hb, hea, heb, he]
  · simp only [true_iff]
    apply List.ext_getElem hl
    intro j ha hb
    have := hx j (by scalar_tac)
    simpa [List.getElem?_eq_getElem ha, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hb] using this

/-- The byte comparator accepts precisely identical spellings. -/
theorem equal_ok (a b : Slice U8) (r : Bool) (h : bytes.equal a b = ok r) :
    (r = true ↔ a.val = b.val) := by
  unfold bytes.equal at h
  h5i_invert h
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff]
    intro he
    have : a.length = b.length := by simp [Slice.length, he]
    simp_all
  · exact equal_loop_ok a b (by scalar_tac) 0#usize r (by simp) h

end oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes

/-- A deduplicated vector drawn from a fixed finite list. -/
def SetWithin (allowed : List U64) (v : alloc.vec.Vec U64) : Prop :=
  v.val.Nodup ∧ v.val ⊆ allowed

theorem within_length {allowed : List U64} {v : alloc.vec.Vec U64}
    (hv : SetWithin allowed v) : v.val.length ≤ allowed.length :=
  (hv.1.subperm hv.2).length_le

theorem append_within {allowed xs : List U64} {x : U64}
    (hd : xs.Nodup) (hs : xs ⊆ allowed) (hx : x ∈ allowed) (hn : x ∉ xs) :
    (xs ++ [x]).Nodup ∧ xs ++ [x] ⊆ allowed := by
  constructor
  · rw [List.nodup_append]
    refine ⟨hd, by simp, ?_⟩
    intro y hy z hz he
    have hz' := List.mem_singleton.mp hz
    exact hn (by simpa only [he, hz'] using hy)
  · intro y hy
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hy with hy | hy
    · exact hs hy
    · simpa using (List.mem_singleton.mp hy) ▸ hx

theorem push_new_within (allowed : List U64) (v : alloc.vec.Vec U64) (x : U64)
    (hb : allowed.length ≤ Usize.max) (hv : SetWithin allowed v) (hx : x ∈ allowed) :
    acl.push_new v x ⦃ w => SetWithin allowed w ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.push_new
  step
  split
  · simp_all
  · rename_i hn
    have hn' : x ∉ v.val := by simpa [w_post, alloc.vec.Vec.deref] using hn
    have ha := append_within hv.1 hv.2 hx hn'
    have hlen := (ha.1.subperm ha.2).length_le
    have hpush : v.val.length < Usize.max := by
      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at hlen
      omega
    step*
    simp_all [SetWithin]

abbrev groupIds (db : model.Db) : List U64 := db.memberships.val.map (·.group_id)

@[step] theorem add_parents_within (db : model.Db) (uid : U64) (found : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (hm : db.memberships.length + 2 ≤ Usize.max) (hf : SetWithin (groupIds db) found) :
    acl.add_parents db uid found ⦃ r => SetWithin (groupIds db) r.1 ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.add_parents acl.add_parents_loop
  refine loop_idx_spec
    (fun (x : alloc.vec.Vec U64 × Bool × Usize) => acl.add_parents_loop.body db uid x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2)
    (fun x => x.2.2) db.memberships.val.length
    (fun x => SetWithin (groupIds db) x.1) (fun r => SetWithin (groupIds db) r.1)
    ?_ _ hf (by simp)
  rintro ⟨out, grew, i⟩ hI hi
  unfold acl.add_parents_loop.body
  h5i_steps
  all_goals simp_all only [SetWithin]
  · have hl := (hI.1.subperm hI.2).length_le
    simp only [List.length_map] at hl
    scalar_tac
  · refine ⟨append_within hI.1 hI.2 ?_ ?_, by scalar_tac, by scalar_tac⟩
    · exact List.mem_map_of_mem (List.getElem_mem _)
    · simp_all [alloc.vec.Vec.deref]

@[step] theorem groups_for_user_within (db : model.Db) (uid : U64)
    (hm : db.memberships.length + 2 ≤ Usize.max) :
    acl.groups_for_user db uid ⦃ v => SetWithin (groupIds db) v ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.groups_for_user acl.groups_for_user_loop
  refine loop_idx_spec
    (fun (x : alloc.vec.Vec U64 × Usize × Bool) =>
      acl.groups_for_user_loop.body db uid x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2)
    (fun x => x.2.1) (db.memberships.val.length + 1)
    (fun x => SetWithin (groupIds db) x.1) (SetWithin (groupIds db))
    ?_ _ (by simp [SetWithin, alloc.vec.Vec.new]) (by simp)
  rintro ⟨found, round, grew⟩ hI hi
  unfold acl.groups_for_user_loop.body
  h5i_steps

theorem expand_loop_within (allowed : List U64) (set direct : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (hb : allowed.length ≤ Usize.max) (hs : SetWithin allowed set)
    (hd : direct.val ⊆ allowed) :
    acl.expand_user_loop set direct 0#usize ⦃ v => SetWithin allowed v ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.expand_user_loop
  refine loop_idx_spec
    (fun (x : alloc.vec.Vec U64 × Usize) => acl.expand_user_loop.body direct x.1 x.2)
    (fun x => x.2) direct.val.length
    (fun x => SetWithin allowed x.1) (SetWithin allowed) ?_ _ hs (by simp)
  rintro ⟨v, i⟩ hv hi
  unfold acl.expand_user_loop.body
  dsimp only
  split
  · step as ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hmem : x ∈ allowed := hd (by simp [hx])
    step with push_new_within allowed v x hb hv hmem
    step*
  · simp [hv]

abbrev userIds (db : model.Db) (uid : U64) : List U64 :=
  uid :: acl.INTERNAL_GROUP_ID :: groupIds db

@[step] theorem expand_user_total (db : model.Db) (uid : U64)
    (hm : db.memberships.length + 2 ≤ Usize.max) :
    acl.expand_user db uid ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
  have hb : (userIds db uid).length ≤ Usize.max := by
    simp only [userIds, groupIds, List.length_cons, List.length_map]
    change db.memberships.val.length + 2 ≤ Usize.max at hm
    omega
  unfold acl.expand_user
  step as ⟨set, hset⟩
  have hs : SetWithin (userIds db uid) set := by simp [SetWithin, hset]
  step as ⟨b⟩
  simp only [bind_ite]
  split
  · step as ⟨direct, hdir⟩
    have hd : direct.val ⊆ userIds db uid :=
      fun _ h => List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (hdir.2 h))
    exact WP.spec_mono (expand_loop_within (userIds db uid) set direct hb hs hd) (by intro _ _; trivial)
  · step with push_new_within (userIds db uid) set acl.INTERNAL_GROUP_ID hb hs (by simp)
      as ⟨set1, hs1⟩
    step as ⟨direct, hdir⟩
    have hd : direct.val ⊆ userIds db uid :=
      fun _ h => List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (hdir.2 h))

@[step] theorem override_bool_spec (d : Bool) (o : Option Bool) :
    drivepolicy.override_bool d o ⦃ r => r = o.getD d ⦄ := by
  cases o <;> simp [drivepolicy.override_bool, Option.getD]

@[step] theorem override_cap_spec (d o : Option U32) :
    drivepolicy.override_cap d o ⦃ r => r = o.or d ⦄ := by
  cases o <;> simp [drivepolicy.override_cap, Option.or]

/-- Missing values inherit defaults, while explicit choices always take precedence. -/
@[step] theorem resolve_spec (d : drivepolicy.Policies) (o : drivepolicy.Overrides) :
    drivepolicy.resolve d o ⦃ r => PolicyResolved d o r ⦄ := by
  unfold drivepolicy.resolve
  step*
  simp_all [PolicyResolved]

/-- Link-specific and broad sharing restrictions both prevent minting. -/
theorem public_links_ok (p : drivepolicy.Policies) (r : core.result.Result Unit model.ErrorKind)
    (h : drivepolicy.refuse_public_links p = ok r) : GuardDecision (PublicLinksAllowed p) r := by
  cases hp : p.forbid_public_links <;> cases hs : p.forbid_sharing <;>
    simp_all [drivepolicy.refuse_public_links, GuardDecision, PublicLinksAllowed] <;>
    subst r <;> simp_all

theorem sharing_ok (p : drivepolicy.Policies) (r : core.result.Result Unit model.ErrorKind)
    (h : drivepolicy.refuse_sharing p = ok r) : GuardDecision (SharingAllowed p) r := by
  cases hs : p.forbid_sharing <;>
    simp_all [drivepolicy.refuse_sharing, GuardDecision, SharingAllowed] <;>
    subst r <;> simp_all

/-- Locking the owner roster constrains non-administrators. -/
theorem owner_changes_ok (p : drivepolicy.Policies) (admin : Bool)
    (r : core.result.Result Unit model.ErrorKind)
    (h : drivepolicy.refuse_owner_role_change p admin = ok r) :
    GuardDecision (OwnerChangesAllowed p admin) r := by
  cases hp : p.forbid_owner_role_change <;> cases admin <;>
    simp_all [drivepolicy.refuse_owner_role_change, GuardDecision, OwnerChangesAllowed] <;>
    subst r <;> simp_all

theorem cross_drive_move_ok (p : drivepolicy.Policies) (r : core.result.Result Unit model.ErrorKind)
    (h : drivepolicy.refuse_cross_drive_move p = ok r) :
    GuardDecision (CrossDriveMoveAllowed p) r := by
  cases hp : p.forbid_cross_drive_move <;>
    simp_all [drivepolicy.refuse_cross_drive_move, GuardDecision, CrossDriveMoveAllowed] <;>
    subst r <;> simp_all

    (r : core.result.Result Unit model.ErrorKind)
    (h : drivepolicy.refuse_external_sharing p s external = ok r) :
    GuardDecision (ExternalSharingAllowed p s external) r := by
  cases hp : p.forbid_external_sharing <;> cases s <;> cases external <;>
    simp_all [drivepolicy.refuse_external_sharing, GuardDecision, ExternalSharingAllowed] <;>
    subst r <;> simp_all <;> aesop

  unfold acl.find_folder acl.find_folder_loop

@[step] theorem find_file_spec (db : model.Db) (id : U64) :

  unfold acl.find_file acl.find_file_loop
  h5i_search_find db.files.val (fun f => decide (f.id = id))

def default_policies : model.DrivePolicies := ⟨false, false, false, false, false⟩

@[step] theorem drive_policies_spec (db : model.Db) (id : U64) :
    acl.drive_policies db id ⦃ result =>
      result = ((driveRow db id).map (·.policies)).getD default_policies ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.drive_policies acl.drive_policies_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search db.drives.val (fun d => decide (d.id = id))
    _root_.id (fun _ d => d.policies) default_policies _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro result hr
    simpa [driveRow, searchFrom_findD] using hr
  · intro i hi
    unfold acl.drive_policies_loop.body
    h5i_step [default_policies]

theorem drive_of_eq (db : model.Db) (r : model.Resource)
    (hs : isStorage r = true) : acl.drive_of db r = ok (driveOf db r) := by
  apply eq_ok_of_spec
  cases r <;> simp [isStorage] at hs
  all_goals
    unfold acl.drive_of driveOf
    step* <;> simp_all
  all_goals exact ⟨_, o_post.symm, rfl⟩

theorem gate_true (p : model.Permission) (hp : p ≠ .Read) :
    acl.read_only_gate_applies p = ok true := by
  cases p <;> simp_all [acl.read_only_gate_applies,
    core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.trait_default, core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.default,
    model.Permission.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqPermission.eq,
    model.Permission.read_discriminant]

theorem drive_read_only_blocks_mutations (db : model.Db) (ro : Bool) (now : I64) (s : model.Subject)
    (p : model.Permission) (r : model.Resource) (d : U64) (dr : model.Drive) (hp : p ≠ .Read)
    (hd : driveOf db r = some d) (hr : driveRow db d = some dr) (hro : dr.policies.read_only = true) :
    acl.check db ro now s p r ≠ ok true := by
  have hg := gate_true p hp
  have hdp : acl.drive_policies db d = ok dr.policies := by
    simpa [hr] using eq_ok_of_spec (drive_policies_spec db d)
  have hd_original := hd
  cases r <;> simp [driveOf] at hd
  all_goals
    unfold acl.check
    simp only [hg, bind_tc_ok]
    cases ro <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ite_true, ite_false, bind_tc_ok]
  all_goals first
    | (simp [hdp, hro, hd]; done)
    | (rw [drive_of_eq db _ (by rfl), hd_original]; simp [hdp, hro])

end oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudDriveReadOnly

  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := h
  simp only [acl.subject_match_set, acl.expand_user, acl.is_external, acl.is_external_loop,
    acl.is_external_loop.body, acl.groups_for_user, acl.groups_for_user_loop,
    acl.groups_for_user_loop.body, acl.add_parents, acl.add_parents_loop, acl.add_parents_loop.body,
    h1, h2]

theorem drive_policies_cong {a b : model.Db} (h : NG a b) (d : U64) :
    acl.drive_policies a d = acl.drive_policies b d := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := h
  simp only [acl.drive_policies, acl.drive_policies_loop, acl.drive_policies_loop.body, h3]

theorem drive_of_cong {a b : model.Db} (h : NG a b) (r : model.Resource) :
    acl.drive_of a r = acl.drive_of b r := by
  simp only [acl.drive_of, find_folder_cong h, find_file_cong h]

theorem file_parent_folder_cong {a b : model.Db} (h : NG a b) (id : U64) :
    acl.file_parent_folder a id = acl.file_parent_folder b id := by
  simp only [acl.file_parent_folder, find_file_cong h]

theorem grant_folder_covers_cong {a b : model.Db} (h : NG a b) (g : model.Grant) (t : Slice U64) :
    acl.grant_folder_covers a g t = acl.grant_folder_covers b g t := by
  simp only [acl.grant_folder_covers, find_folder_cong h]

/-! ## Per-grant tests, as plain functions -/

theorem resource_eq_ok (a b : model.Resource) :
    model.Resource.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqResource.eq a b = ok (decide (a = b)) := by
  unfold model.Resource.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqResource.eq
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp [lift, model.Resource.read_discriminant]

@[step] theorem resource_eq_spec (a b : model.Resource) :
    model.Resource.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqResource.eq a b ⦃ r => r = decide (a = b) ⦄ := by
  simp [resource_eq_ok]

theorem role_eq_ok (a b : model.Role) :
    model.Role.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqRole.eq a b = ok (decide (a = b)) := by
  unfold model.Role.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqRole.eq
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp [model.Role.read_discriminant]

@[step] theorem contains_spec (ids : Slice U64) (x : U64) :
    acl.contains ids x ⦃ b => b = ids.val.any (· == x) ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.contains acl.contains_loop
  h5i_search_any ids.val (fun y => y == x)

@[step] theorem contains_u8_spec (ids : Slice U8) (x : U8) :
    acl.contains_u8 ids x ⦃ b => b = ids.val.any (· == x) ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.contains_u8 acl.contains_u8_loop
  h5i_search_any ids.val (fun y => y == x)

def stype : model.Subject → U8
  | .User _ => 0#u8
  | .Group _ => 1#u8
  | .Token _ => 2#u8

def sid : model.Subject → U64
  | .User x | .Group x | .Token x => x

def SM (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) (g : model.Grant) : Bool :=
  types.val.any (· == stype g.subject) && ids.val.any (· == sid g.subject)

@[step] theorem subject_matches_spec (g : model.Grant) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) :
    acl.subject_matches g types ids ⦃ b => b = SM types ids g ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.subject_matches
  cases h : g.subject <;> simp only [acl.subject_type, acl.subject_id] <;> step* <;>
    simp_all [SM, stype, sid]
  all_goals (intro hm; have := b_post _ hm; simp at this)

/-- The value of a run that succeeds. -/
noncomputable def pv (m : Result Bool) : Bool :=
  open Classical in if h : ∃ b, m = ok b then h.choose else false

theorem pv_eq {m : Result Bool} (h : ∃ b, m = ok b) : m = ok (pv m) := by
  rw [pv, dif_pos h]; exact h.choose_spec

noncomputable def RI (role : model.Role) (p : model.Permission) : Bool := pv (acl.role_implies role p)

@[step] theorem role_implies_spec (role : model.Role) (p : model.Permission) :
    acl.role_implies role p ⦃ b => b = RI role p ⦄ := by
  have : ∃ b, acl.role_implies role p = ok b := by
    cases role <;> cases p <;> simp [acl.role_implies, role_eq_ok]
  rw [pv_eq this]; simp [RI]

theorem live_ok (g : model.Grant) (now : I64) : acl.live g now = ok (live g now) := by
  unfold acl.live live
  cases g.expires_at <;> simp

@[step] theorem live_spec (g : model.Grant) (now : I64) : acl.live g now ⦃ b => b = live g now ⦄ := by
  simp [live_ok]

def rank : model.Role → Nat
  | .Owner => 0
  | .Editor => 1
  | .Contributor => 2
  | .Commenter => 3
  | .Viewer => 4

def STR (a : Option model.Role) (b : model.Role) : Option model.Role :=
  match a with
  | none => some b
  | some x => if rank b < rank x then some b else some x

@[step] theorem stronger_spec (a : Option model.Role) (b : model.Role) :
    acl.stronger a b ⦃ r => r = STR a b ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.stronger STR
  cases a with
  | none => simp
  | some x => cases b <;> cases x <;> simp [acl.role_rank, rank]

theorem lpath_contains_total (a b : Slice U64) : acl.lpath_contains a b ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.lpath_contains
  simp only
  split
  · simp
  · have hab : a.length ≤ b.length := by scalar_tac
    unfold acl.lpath_contains_loop
    apply H5iAppLib.loop_idx_spec _ (fun i => i) a.length (fun _ => True) _ ?step _ trivial (by simp)
    intro x _ hx
    unfold acl.lpath_contains_loop.body
    step*

@[step] theorem find_folder_spec (db : model.Db) (id : U64) :
    acl.find_folder db id ⦃ o => o = db.folders.val.find? (·.id == id) ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.find_folder acl.find_folder_loop
  h5i_search_find db.folders.val (fun f => f.id == id)

noncomputable def COV (db : model.Db) (t : Slice U64) (g : model.Grant) : Bool :=
  pv (acl.grant_folder_covers db g t)

@[step] theorem grant_folder_covers_spec (db : model.Db) (g : model.Grant) (t : Slice U64) :
    acl.grant_folder_covers db g t ⦃ b => b = COV db t g ⦄ := by
  have : ∃ b, acl.grant_folder_covers db g t = ok b := by
    unfold acl.grant_folder_covers
    cases g.resource <;> simp
    rename_i fid
    obtain ⟨o, ho⟩ := ok_of (find_folder_spec db fid)
    rw [ho]
    cases o with
    | none => simp
    | some gf =>
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := ok_of (lpath_contains_total (alloc.vec.Vec.deref gf.lpath) t)
      simp [hr]
  rw [pv_eq this]; simp [COV]

/-! ## The three loops over the grants -/

def CS (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) (d : U64) (now : I64) (acc : Option model.Role)
    (g : model.Grant) : Option model.Role :=
  if SM types ids g && decide (g.resource = .Drive d) && live g now then STR acc g.role else acc

theorem direct_loop_spec (db : model.Db) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) (p : model.Permission)
    (r : model.Resource) (now : I64) :
    acl.direct_grant_exists_loop db types ids p r now 0#usize ⦃ b => b =
      db.grants.val.any (fun g => SM types ids g && RI g.role p && decide (g.resource = r) && live g now) ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.direct_grant_exists_loop
  h5i_search_any db.grants.val (fun g => SM types ids g && RI g.role p && decide (g.resource = r) && live g now)

theorem folder_loop_spec (db : model.Db) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) (p : model.Permission)
    (now : I64) (target : alloc.vec.Vec U64) :
    acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop db types ids p now target 0#usize ⦃ b => b =
      db.grants.val.any (fun g => SM types ids g && RI g.role p && live g now &&
        COV db (alloc.vec.Vec.deref target) g) ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop
  h5i_search_any db.grants.val (fun g => SM types ids g && RI g.role p && live g now &&
    COV db (alloc.vec.Vec.deref target) g)

theorem caller_loop_spec (db : model.Db) (d : U64) (now : I64) (types : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (ids : alloc.vec.Vec U64) (best : Option model.Role) :
    acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop db d now types ids best 0#usize ⦃ r => r =
      db.grants.val.foldl (CS (alloc.vec.Vec.deref types) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ids) d now) best ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (H5iAppLib.loop_fold db.grants.val id
    (CS (alloc.vec.Vec.deref types) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ids) d now) (fun _ _ => True) _ ?step best 0#usize
    (by simp) trivial)
  · intro r hr; simpa using hr
  case step =>
    intro s i hi _
    simp only
    unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop.body
    h5i_step [CS]

/-! ## Equal results on the two databases -/

theorem direct_eq {a b : model.Db} (hg : a.grants.val = b.grants.val.filter (fun g => live g now))
    (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) (p : model.Permission) (r : model.Resource) :
    acl.direct_grant_exists a types ids p r now = acl.direct_grant_exists b types ids p r now := by
  unfold acl.direct_grant_exists
  rw [eq_ok_of_spec (direct_loop_spec a types ids p r now), eq_ok_of_spec (direct_loop_spec b types ids p r now),
    hg, any_filter_of_imp]
  intro x _ hx
  simp_all

theorem folder_loop_eq {a b : model.Db} (h : NG a b)
    (hg : a.grants.val = b.grants.val.filter (fun g => live g now))
    (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) (p : model.Permission) (target : alloc.vec.Vec U64) :
    acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop a types ids p now target 0#usize =
      acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop b types ids p now target 0#usize := by
  rw [eq_ok_of_spec (folder_loop_spec a types ids p now target),
    eq_ok_of_spec (folder_loop_spec b types ids p now target), hg, any_filter_of_imp]
  · simp only [COV, grant_folder_covers_cong h]
  · intro x _ hx
    simp_all

theorem folder_eq {a b : model.Db} (h : NG a b)
    (hg : a.grants.val = b.grants.val.filter (fun g => live g now))
    (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) (p : model.Permission) (fid : U64) :
    acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists a types ids p fid now =
      acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists b types ids p fid now := by
  simp only [acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists, find_folder_cong h, folder_loop_eq h hg]

theorem caller_eq {a b : model.Db} (h : NG a b)
    (hg : a.grants.val = b.grants.val.filter (fun g => live g now)) (s : model.Subject) (d : U64) :
    acl.caller_role_on_drive a s d now = acl.caller_role_on_drive b s d now := by
  have hl : ∀ types ids, acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop a d now types ids none 0#usize =
      acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop b d now types ids none 0#usize := by
    intro types ids
    rw [eq_ok_of_spec (caller_loop_spec a d now types ids none),
      eq_ok_of_spec (caller_loop_spec b d now types ids none), hg, foldl_filter_of_skip]
    intro acc x hx
    simp [CS, hx]
  simp only [acl.caller_role_on_drive, subject_match_set_cong h, hl]

theorem cascade_eq {a b : model.Db} (h : NG a b)
    (hg : a.grants.val = b.grants.val.filter (fun g => live g now))
    (s : model.Subject) (r : model.Resource) (p : model.Permission) :
    acl.cascade_grant a s r p now = acl.cascade_grant b s r p now := by
  simp only [acl.cascade_grant, subject_match_set_cong h, file_parent_folder_cong h, folder_eq h hg,
    direct_eq hg]

theorem expired_grants_ignored (db db' : model.Db) (ro : Bool) (now : I64) (s : model.Subject)
    (p : model.Permission) (r : model.Resource) (hs : SameButGrants db db')
    (hg : db'.grants.val = db.grants.val.filter (fun g => live g now)) :
    acl.check db' ro now s p r = acl.check db ro now s p r := by
  have h : NG db' db := ⟨hs.1.symm, hs.2.1.symm, hs.2.2.1.symm, hs.2.2.2.1.symm, hs.2.2.2.2.symm⟩
  simp only [acl.check, drive_of_cong h, drive_policies_cong h, caller_eq h hg, cascade_eq h hg,
    subject_match_set_cong h, direct_eq hg]

end oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudExpiredGrants

import Verified.Derived
import Spec
import H5iAppLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result oxicloud_kernel oxicloud_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit

namespace oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudKeepsOwner



@[step] theorem role_eq_spec (a b : model.Role) :
    model.Role.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqRole.eq a b ⦃ r => r = decide (a = b) ⦄ := by
  unfold model.Role.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqRole.eq
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp [model.Role.read_discriminant]

@[step] theorem resource_eq_spec (a b : model.Resource) :
    model.Resource.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqResource.eq a b ⦃ r => r = decide (a = b) ⦄ := by
  unfold model.Resource.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqResource.eq
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp [model.Resource.read_discriminant, lift, core.cmp.impls.PartialEqU64.eq]

@[step] theorem subject_eq_spec (a b : model.Subject) :
    model.Subject.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqSubject.eq a b ⦃ r => r = decide (a = b) ⦄ := by
  unfold model.Subject.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqSubject.eq
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp [model.Subject.read_discriminant, lift, core.cmp.impls.PartialEqU64.eq]

theorem subject_is_owner_spec (db : model.Db) (d : U64) (s : model.Subject) :
    grantapi.subject_is_owner db d s ⦃ b => b = db.grants.val.any
      (fun g => decide (g.resource = .Drive d ∧ g.subject = s ∧ g.role = .Owner)) ⦄ := by
  unfold grantapi.subject_is_owner grantapi.subject_is_owner_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search db.grants.val
    (fun g => decide (g.resource = .Drive d ∧ g.subject = s ∧ g.role = .Owner)) (fun b : Bool => b)
    (fun _ _ => true) false _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro r hr; exact search_any _ _ _ hr
  · intro j hj; unfold grantapi.subject_is_owner_loop.body; h5i_step


theorem owner_count_spec (db : model.Db) (d : U64) :
    grantapi.owner_count db d ⦃ n => n.val = ownerCount db d ⦄ := by
  unfold grantapi.owner_count grantapi.owner_count_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_fold db.grants.val (fun n : Usize => n.val)
    (fun c g => c + if decide (g.resource = .Drive d ∧ g.role = .Owner) then 1 else 0)
    (fun n i => n.val ≤ i) _ ?_ 0#usize 0#usize (by simp) (by simp))
  · intro r hr; rw [hr, foldl_count]; simp [ownerCount]
  · intro n j hj hn; unfold grantapi.owner_count_loop.body; h5i_step


theorem push_ok {α} {v w : alloc.vec.Vec α} {x : α} (h : v.push x = ok w) : w.val = v.val ++ [x] := by
  unfold alloc.vec.Vec.push at h; simp only at h
  split at h
  · simp at h; subst h; simp
  · simp at h

@[step] theorem same_key_spec (g : model.Grant) (s : model.Subject) (r : model.Resource) :
    acl.same_key g s r ⦃ b => b = decide (g.subject = s ∧ g.resource = r) ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.same_key
  step*

/-- What `set_role` does to each existing grant. -/
def upd (s : model.Subject) (r : model.Resource) (role : model.Role) (gb : U64) (e : Option I64)
    (g : model.Grant) : model.Grant :=
  if g.subject = s ∧ g.resource = r then
    { g with subject := s, resource := r, role, granted_by := gb, expires_at := e }
  else g

theorem set_role_loop_ok (grants : Slice model.Grant) (gb : U64) (s : model.Subject)
    (role : model.Role) (r : model.Resource) (e : Option I64)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec model.Grant) (fresh : U64) (found : Bool) (i : Usize)
    out' fresh' found'
    (h : acl.set_role_loop grants gb s role r e out fresh found i = ok (out', fresh', found'))
    (hinv : out.val = (grants.val.take i.val).map (upd s r role gb e))
    (hf : found = true → ∃ g ∈ out.val, g.resource = r ∧ g.role = role)
    (hi : i.val ≤ grants.val.length) :
    out'.val = grants.val.map (upd s r role gb e) ∧
      (found' = true → ∃ g ∈ out'.val, g.resource = r ∧ g.role = role) := by
  unfold acl.set_role_loop at h
  refine loop_idx_ok _ (fun x => x.2.2.2) grants.val.length
    (fun x => x.1.val = (grants.val.take x.2.2.2.val).map (upd s r role gb e) ∧
      (x.2.2.1 = true → ∃ g ∈ x.1.val, g.resource = r ∧ g.role = role))
    (fun y => y.1.val = grants.val.map (upd s r role gb e) ∧
      (y.2.2 = true → ∃ g ∈ y.1.val, g.resource = r ∧ g.role = role)) ?_ _ _ ⟨hinv, hf⟩ hi h
  rintro ⟨o, fr, fd, j⟩ res ⟨h1, h2⟩ hle hr
  simp only at h1 h2 hle hr ⊢
  unfold acl.set_role_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨hj, rfl⟩ := slice_index_ok hg
    have hb' := post_of_ok (same_key_spec _ _ _) hb
    obtain ⟨out1, i2, found1⟩ := x
    obtain ⟨i3, hi3, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp hr
    have hi3v : i3.val = j.val + 1 := by have := add_ok_val hi3; simp at this; omega
    have := Result.ok.inj hr; subst this
    simp only
    have htake : (grants.val.take (j.val + 1)) = grants.val.take j.val ++ [grants.val[j.val]] := by
      rw [List.take_add_one, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj]; rfl
    split at hx
    · rename_i hbt
      obtain ⟨out2, hp, hx⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp hx
      have := Result.ok.inj hx; simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at this
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := this
      have hp' := push_ok hp
      subst hbt
      have hk : grants.val[j.val].subject = s ∧ grants.val[j.val].resource = r := by simpa using hb'
      refine ⟨⟨?_, fun _ => ⟨{ id := grants.val[j.val].id, subject := s, resource := r, role, granted_by := gb, expires_at := e }, by rw [hp']; simp, rfl, rfl⟩⟩, by scalar_tac, by scalar_tac⟩
      rw [hp', hi3v, htake, h1, List.map_append]; simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, upd, hk]; simp
    · rename_i hbt
      obtain ⟨out2, hp, hx⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp hx
      have := Result.ok.inj hx; simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at this
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := this
      have hp' := push_ok hp
      have hk : ¬ (grants.val[j.val].subject = s ∧ grants.val[j.val].resource = r) := by
        simp at hbt; simpa [hbt] using hb'
      refine ⟨⟨?_, fun hf => ?_⟩, by scalar_tac, by scalar_tac⟩
      · rw [hp', hi3v, htake, h1, List.map_append]; simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, upd, hk]; simp
      · obtain ⟨g, hg, hg'⟩ := h2 hf; exact ⟨g, by rw [hp']; simp [hg], hg'⟩
  · have hlen : grants.val.length ≤ j.val := by scalar_tac
    simp only
    rw [List.take_of_length_le hlen] at h1
    exact ⟨h1, h2⟩

theorem set_role_ok (grants : Slice model.Grant) (gb : U64) (s : model.Subject)
    (role : model.Role) (r : model.Resource) (e : Option I64) (fresh : U64) out res
    (h : acl.set_role grants gb s role r e fresh = ok (out, res)) :
    (∃ extra : List model.Grant, out.val = grants.val.map (upd s r role gb e) ++ extra ∧
      ∀ g ∈ extra, g.role = role) ∧ (∃ g ∈ out.val, g.resource = r ∧ g.role = role) := by
  unfold acl.set_role at h
  h5i_invert h
  obtain ⟨o, i, found⟩ := x
  have hl := set_role_loop_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hx (by simp) (by simp) (by simp)
  obtain ⟨hl1, hl2⟩ := hl
  cases found
  · simp at h
    obtain ⟨o2, hp, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
    simp only [Result.ok.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
    rw [push_ok hp, hl1]
    exact ⟨⟨_, rfl, by simp⟩, { id := i, subject := s, resource := r, role, granted_by := gb, expires_at := e },
      by simp, rfl, rfl⟩
  · simp at h
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
    exact ⟨⟨[], by simp [hl1], by simp⟩, hl2 rfl⟩

def isOwnerOn (d : U64) (g : model.Grant) : Bool := decide (g.resource = .Drive d ∧ g.role = .Owner)

def isOwnerAs (d : U64) (s : model.Subject) (g : model.Grant) : Bool :=
  decide (g.resource = .Drive d ∧ g.subject = s ∧ g.role = .Owner)


theorem ownerCount_eq (db : model.Db) (d : U64) :
    ownerCount db d = db.grants.val.countP (isOwnerOn d) := by
  rw [ownerCount, List.countP_eq_length_filter]; rfl
theorem count_upd (l : List model.Grant) (d : U64) (s : model.Subject) (role : model.Role) (gb : U64)
    (e : Option I64) (hrole : role ≠ .Owner) :
    (l.map (upd s (.Drive d) role gb e)).countP (isOwnerOn d) + l.countP (isOwnerAs d s) =
      l.countP (isOwnerOn d) := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.countP_cons]
    by_cases hk : a.subject = s ∧ a.resource = .Drive d
    · simp [upd, hk, isOwnerOn, isOwnerAs, hrole, -List.countP_map]; omega
    · simp only [upd, hk, if_false]
      have : isOwnerAs d s a = false := by
        simp only [isOwnerAs, decide_eq_false_iff_not]; tauto
      simp [this, -List.countP_map]; omega

theorem count_as_le (l : List model.Grant) (d : U64) (s : model.Subject)
    (hu : (l.map (fun g => (g.subject, g.resource))).Nodup) : l.countP (isOwnerAs d s) ≤ 1 := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.nodup_cons, List.mem_map] at hu
    rw [List.countP_cons]
    by_cases ha : isOwnerAs d s a = true
    · have : l.countP (isOwnerAs d s) = 0 := by
        rw [List.countP_eq_zero]
        intro x hx hx'
        simp only [isOwnerAs, decide_eq_true_eq] at ha hx'
        exact hu.1 ⟨x, hx, by rw [ha.1, ha.2.1, hx'.1, hx'.2.1]⟩
      simp [ha, this]
    · simp [ha]; exact ih hu.2

theorem last_owner_ok (db : model.Db) (d : U64) (s : model.Subject)
    (h : grantapi.refuse_if_last_owner_change db d s = ok (.Ok ())) :
    db.grants.val.countP (isOwnerAs d s) = 0 ∨ 2 ≤ ownerCount db d := by
  unfold grantapi.refuse_if_last_owner_change at h
  h5i_invert h
  · have := post_of_ok (owner_count_spec db d) hi
    right; rw [← this]; scalar_tac
  · have hb' := post_of_ok (subject_is_owner_spec db d s) hb
    left; rw [List.countP_eq_zero]; intro x hx hx'
    apply hc; rw [hb']; exact List.any_eq_true.mpr ⟨x, hx, by simpa [isOwnerAs] using hx'⟩

theorem set_member_role_keeps (db db' : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller d : U64)
    (s : model.Subject) (role : model.Role) (e : Option I64) (rep : grantapi.Reply)
    (hu : GrantsUnique db) (ho : 0 < ownerCount db d)
    (h : grantapi.set_member_role db env caller d s role e = ok (db', .Ok rep)) :
    0 < ownerCount db' d := by
  unfold grantapi.set_member_role grantapi.with_grants at h
  h5i_invert h
  · h5i_invert hgates
    all_goals
      obtain ⟨grants, g⟩ := x
      simp at h
      obtain ⟨_, _, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
      obtain ⟨_, _, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
      obtain ⟨_, _, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
      obtain ⟨_, _, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
      obtain ⟨_, _, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
      simp only [Result.ok.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨rfl, -⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨⟨extra, hex, hexr⟩, ⟨g0, hg0, hg0r, hg0role⟩⟩ := set_role_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hx
      have hb' := post_of_ok (core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.default.spec _ _ _
        (by apply WP.spec_mono (role_eq_spec _ _); intro r hr; simp [hr])) hb
    · have hro : role ≠ .Owner := hb'.mp hc
      cases a
      have hl := last_owner_ok db d s hgates
      have hd : (db.grants.deref).val = db.grants.val := by simp [alloc.vec.Vec.deref]
      rw [hd] at hex
      rw [ownerCount_eq] at ho ⊢
      simp only [hex, List.countP_append]
      have hc := count_upd db.grants.val d s role caller e hro
      rcases hl with hl | hl
      · omega
      · rw [ownerCount_eq] at hl
        have := count_as_le db.grants.val d s hu
        omega
    · have hro : role = .Owner := by simpa using mt hb'.mpr hc
      rw [ownerCount_eq]
      exact List.countP_pos_iff.mpr ⟨g0, hg0, by simp [isOwnerOn, hg0r, hg0role, hro]⟩
  · exact h.2.elim
theorem drive_keeps_an_owner (db db' : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller d : U64) (s : model.Subject)
    (role : model.Role) (e : Option I64) (req : grantapi.Request) (rep : grantapi.Reply)
    (hq : req = .CreateGrant (.Drive d) s role e ∨ req = .SetRole (.Drive d) s role e)
    (hu : GrantsUnique db)
    (ho : 0 < ownerCount db d) (h : grantapi.transition db env caller req = ok (db', .Ok rep)) :
    0 < ownerCount db' d := by
  rcases hq with rfl | rfl
  · unfold grantapi.transition grantapi.create_grant at h
    h5i_invert h
    all_goals first | exact h.2.elim | exact set_member_role_keeps _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hu ho h
  · unfold grantapi.transition grantapi.set_role_handler at h
    h5i_invert h
    all_goals first | exact h.2.elim | exact set_member_role_keeps _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hu ho h

end oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudKeepsOwner

import Verified.OxicloudUserRole
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result oxicloud_kernel oxicloud_kernel.SpecKernel
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
open oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes
namespace oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudLiveAuth

theorem internal_ok (flags : liveauth.FlagsLookup) (id : U128)
    (r : core.result.Result Unit liveauth.InternalDenial)
    (h : liveauth.decide_internal_user flags id = ok r) :
    (r = .Ok () ↔ InternalAccountAllowed flags) ∧
    (∀ reason, r = .Err reason → InternalAccountDenied flags reason) := by
  cases flags with
  | Found f =>
    rcases f with ⟨role, external, active, change⟩
    cases external <;> simp_all [liveauth.decide_internal_user, InternalAccountAllowed, InternalAccountDenied]
    all_goals subst_vars
    all_goals simp_all [InternalAccountDenied]
  | NotFound =>
    simp_all [liveauth.decide_internal_user, InternalAccountAllowed, InternalAccountDenied]
    subst_vars
    simp_all [InternalAccountDenied]
  | Unavailable =>
    simp_all [liveauth.decide_internal_user, InternalAccountAllowed, InternalAccountDenied]
    subst_vars
    simp

theorem live_role_ok (flags : liveauth.FlagsLookup) (id : U128) (claim : Slice U8)
    (r : liveauth.LiveRole) (h : liveauth.decide_live_role flags id claim = ok r) :
    LiveAccountRole flags claim.val r := by
  cases flags with
  | Found f =>
    rcases f with ⟨role, external, active, change⟩
    cases active <;> unfold liveauth.decide_live_role at h <;> h5i_invert h
    · simp [LiveAccountRole]
    · have hr := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudUserRole.as_bytes_ok _ _ hv
      simpa [LiveAccountRole] using hr
  | NotFound =>
    unfold liveauth.decide_live_role at h
    h5i_invert h
    simp [LiveAccountRole]
  | Unavailable =>
    unfold liveauth.decide_live_role at h
    h5i_invert h
    exact copy_ok _ _ hv

theorem anonymous_ok (claim : Slice U8) (r : Option liveauth.LiveRole)
    (h : liveauth.anonymous_live_role claim = ok r) : AnonymousLiveRole claim.val r := by
  unfold liveauth.anonymous_live_role at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals have hs := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudUserRole.session_ok claim _ ho
  · have hn := hs .Anonymous
    simp only [SessionRole, reduceCtorEq, false_iff] at hn
    simp [AnonymousLiveRole, hn]
  · have ha : role = .Anonymous :=
      (oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudUserRole.anonymous_ok role b hb).1 hc
    subst role
    have hp : claim.val = RoleWire .Anonymous := (hs .Anonymous).1 rfl
    have hw := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudUserRole.as_bytes_ok _ _ hv
    constructor
    · simp [hp]
    · intro value he
      have he' : liveauth.LiveRole.Active v = value := Option.some.inj he
      subst value
      exact ⟨v, rfl, hw, hp⟩
  · have hn : claim.val ≠ RoleWire .Anonymous := by
      intro he
      have hr : role = .Anonymous := Option.some.inj ((hs .Anonymous).2 he)
      exact hc ((oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudUserRole.anonymous_ok role b hb).2 hr)
    simp [AnonymousLiveRole, hn]

end oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudLiveAuth

theorem resource_bytes_ok (value : magiclink.MagicLinkResourceKind) (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)

theorem resource_parse_ok (raw : Slice U8) (o : Option magiclink.MagicLinkResourceKind)

    (o = some value ↔ raw.val = MagicResourceWire value) := by
  unfold magiclink.resource_parse at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals simp only [lift, Result.ok.injEq] at *
  all_goals subst_vars
  all_goals have he := equal_ok _ _ _ hb
  all_goals try have he1 := equal_ok _ _ _ hb1
  all_goals cases value <;> simp_all [MagicResourceWire, Array.to_slice, Array.make]

theorem status_parse_ok (raw : Slice U8) (o : Option magiclink.MagicLinkStatus)
    (h : magiclink.status_parse raw = ok o) (value : magiclink.MagicLinkStatus) :
    (o = some value ↔ raw.val = MagicStatusWire value) := by
  unfold magiclink.status_parse at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals simp only [lift, Result.ok.injEq] at *
  all_goals subst_vars
  all_goals have he := equal_ok _ _ _ hb
  all_goals try have he1 := equal_ok _ _ _ hb1
  all_goals try have he2 := equal_ok _ _ _ hb2
  all_goals cases value <;> simp_all [MagicStatusWire, Array.to_slice, Array.make]

theorem restored_readback (snapshot r : magiclink.MagicLinkToken)
    (h : magiclink.from_raw snapshot.id snapshot.token snapshot.user_id snapshot.status snapshot.issued_at snapshot.expires_at snapshot.used_at snapshot.resource_kind snapshot.resource_id snapshot.request_challenge = ok r) :
    magiclink.id r = ok snapshot.id ∧
    magiclink.token r = ok snapshot.token ∧
    magiclink.user_id r = ok snapshot.user_id ∧
    magiclink.status r = ok snapshot.status ∧
    magiclink.issued_at r = ok snapshot.issued_at ∧
    magiclink.expires_at r = ok snapshot.expires_at ∧
    magiclink.used_at r = ok snapshot.used_at ∧
    magiclink.resource_kind r = ok snapshot.resource_kind ∧
    magiclink.resource_id r = ok snapshot.resource_id ∧
    magiclink.request_challenge r = ok snapshot.request_challenge := by
  simp only [magiclink.from_raw, Result.ok.injEq] at h
  subst r
  simp [magiclink.id, magiclink.token, magiclink.user_id, magiclink.status, magiclink.issued_at, magiclink.expires_at, magiclink.used_at, magiclink.resource_kind, magiclink.resource_id, magiclink.request_challenge]

theorem expired_ok (s : magiclink.MagicLinkToken) (now : session.Timestamp) (r : Bool)
    (h : magiclink.is_expired s now = ok r) : (r = true ↔ TimestampPast now s.expires_at) := by

  h5i_invert h <;> simp_all [TimestampPast] <;> scalar_tac

theorem redeemable_ok (s : magiclink.MagicLinkToken) (now : session.Timestamp) (r : Bool)

  unfold magiclink.is_redeemable at h
  h5i_invert h
  · have he := expired_ok s now b hb
    cases b <;> simp_all [MagicLinkRedeemable, TimestampPast, TimestampWithin] <;> omega
  · simp [MagicLinkRedeemable, hc]
  · simp [MagicLinkRedeemable, hc]

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

@[step] theorem find_drive_spec (db : model.Db) (id : U64) :
    grantapi.find_drive db id ⦃ result => result = driveRow db id ⦄ := by
  unfold grantapi.find_drive grantapi.find_drive_loop driveRow
  h5i_search_find db.drives.val (fun d => decide (d.id = id))

theorem personal_refused (db : model.Db) (d : U64) (dr : model.Drive)
    (hr : driveRow db d = some dr) (hk : dr.kind = .Personal) :
    grantapi.refuse_if_personal db d = ok (.Err .OperationNotSupported) := by
  unfold grantapi.refuse_if_personal
  rw [eq_ok_of_spec (find_drive_spec db d)]
  simp [hr, hk, model.DriveKind.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqDriveKind.eq,
    model.DriveKind.read_discriminant]

theorem member_personal_refused (db db' : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller d : U64)
    (s : model.Subject) (role : model.Role) (e : Option I64) (dr : model.Drive)
    (hr : driveRow db d = some dr) (hk : dr.kind = .Personal)
    (out : core.result.Result grantapi.Reply model.ErrorKind)
    (h : grantapi.set_member_role db env caller d s role e = ok (db', out)) :
    db' = db ∧ ∃ err, out = .Err err := by
  unfold grantapi.set_member_role at h
  obtain ⟨decision, hd, h⟩ := bind_eq_ok.1 h
  cases decision <;> simp [personal_refused db d dr hr hk] at h
  all_goals h5i_invert h
  all_goals simp_all
  all_goals exact ⟨_, h.2.symm⟩

theorem personal_drive_members_fixed (db db' : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller d : U64)
    (s : model.Subject) (role : model.Role) (e : Option I64) (req : grantapi.Request)
    (dr : model.Drive) (hr : driveRow db d = some dr) (hk : dr.kind = .Personal)
    (hq : req = .CreateGrant (.Drive d) s role e ∨ req = .SetRole (.Drive d) s role e)
    (out : core.result.Result grantapi.Reply model.ErrorKind)
    (h : grantapi.transition db env caller req = ok (db', out)) :
    db' = db ∧ ∃ err, out = .Err err := by
  rcases hq with rfl | rfl
  · unfold grantapi.transition grantapi.create_grant at h
    h5i_invert h
    all_goals first
      | exact member_personal_refused db db' env caller d s role e dr hr hk out h
      | (simp_all; exact ⟨_, h.2.symm⟩)
  · unfold grantapi.transition grantapi.set_role_handler at h
    h5i_invert h
    all_goals first
      | exact member_personal_refused db db' env caller d s role e dr hr hk out h
      | (simp_all; exact ⟨_, h.2.symm⟩)

import Verified.OxicloudDrivePolicy
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result oxicloud_kernel oxicloud_kernel.PolicySpec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
namespace oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudPolicyCompare
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

theorem push_ok {α} {v w : alloc.vec.Vec α} {x : α} (h : v.push x = ok w) : w.val = v.val ++ [x] := by
  unfold alloc.vec.Vec.push at h; simp only at h
  split at h
  · simp at h; subst h; simp
  · simp at h


theorem knobs_ok (r : alloc.vec.Vec policycompare.Knob)
    (h : policycompare.policy_knobs = ok r) : r.val = PolicyKnobOrder := by
  unfold policycompare.policy_knobs at h
  h5i_invert h
  have hp0 := push_ok hout
  have hp1 := push_ok hout1
  have hp2 := push_ok hout2
  have hp3 := push_ok hout3
  have hp4 := push_ok hout4
  have hp5 := push_ok hout5
  have hp6 := push_ok hout6
  have hp7 := push_ok hout7
  have hp8 := push_ok hout8
  have hp9 := push_ok h
  simp_all [alloc.vec.Vec.new, PolicyKnobOrder]

theorem non_defaultable_ok (r : alloc.vec.Vec policycompare.Knob)
    (h : policycompare.non_defaultable_knobs = ok r) : r.val = [.ReadOnly] := by
  unfold policycompare.non_defaultable_knobs at h
  have hp := push_ok h
  simpa [alloc.vec.Vec.new] using hp

theorem applies_ok (knob : policycompare.Knob) (kind : model.DriveKind) (b : Bool)
    (h : policycompare.knob_applies_to_kind knob kind = ok b) :
    (b = true ↔ PolicyApplies knob kind) := by
  cases knob <;> cases kind <;> simp_all [policycompare.knob_applies_to_kind, PolicyApplies]

theorem strictness_ok (knob : policycompare.Knob) (r : policycompare.Strictness)
    (h : policycompare.knob_strictness knob = ok r) : PolicyStrictness knob r := by
  cases knob <;> simp_all [policycompare.knob_strictness, PolicyStrictness]

theorem value_ok (p : drivepolicy.Policies) (knob : policycompare.Knob) (r : policycompare.KnobValue)
    (h : policycompare.knob_value p knob = ok r) : PolicyValue p knob r := by
  cases knob <;> simp_all [policycompare.knob_value, PolicyValue, PolicyBit]
  cases hc : p.max_public_link_days <;> simp_all

theorem bool_ok (p : drivepolicy.Policies) (knob : policycompare.Knob) (b : Bool)
    (h : policycompare.knob_bool p knob = ok b) : b = PolicyBit p knob := by
  cases knob <;> simp_all [policycompare.knob_bool, policycompare.knob_value, PolicyBit]
  cases hc : p.max_public_link_days <;> simp_all

theorem refinement_ok (p q : drivepolicy.Policies) (knob : policycompare.Knob) (b : Bool)
    (h : policycompare.at_least_as_strict_on p q knob = ok b) :
    (b = true ↔ PolicyRefines p q knob) := by
  cases knob <;> simp_all [policycompare.at_least_as_strict_on, policycompare.knob_strictness,
    policycompare.knob_bool, policycompare.knob_value, PolicyRefines, PolicyBit, PolicyCapRefines]
  all_goals repeat' (split at h <;> simp_all)
  all_goals subst_vars
  all_goals simp_all

theorem cap_refines_refl (cap : Option U32) : PolicyCapRefines cap cap := by
  intro bound hb
  exact ⟨bound, hb, Nat.le_refl _⟩

theorem cap_refines_trans {a b c : Option U32}
    (hab : PolicyCapRefines a b) (hbc : PolicyCapRefines b c) : PolicyCapRefines a c := by
  intro bound hc
  obtain ⟨middle, hm, hmb⟩ := hbc bound hc
  obtain ⟨own, ho, hom⟩ := hab middle hm
  exact ⟨own, ho, hom.trans hmb⟩

theorem refinement_refl (p : drivepolicy.Policies) (knob : policycompare.Knob) : PolicyRefines p p knob := by
  cases knob <;> first | exact cap_refines_refl _ | exact fun h => h

theorem refinement_trans {p q r : drivepolicy.Policies} (knob : policycompare.Knob)
    (hpq : PolicyRefines p q knob) (hqr : PolicyRefines q r knob) : PolicyRefines p r knob := by
  cases knob <;> first
    | exact cap_refines_trans hpq hqr
    | exact fun h => hpq (hqr h)
    | exact fun h => hqr (hpq h)

theorem checked_refinement_transitive (p q r : drivepolicy.Policies) (knob : policycompare.Knob)
    (hpq : policycompare.at_least_as_strict_on p q knob = ok true)
    (hqr : policycompare.at_least_as_strict_on q r knob = ok true)
    (b : Bool) (hpr : policycompare.at_least_as_strict_on p r knob = ok b) : b = true := by
  exact (refinement_ok p r knob b hpr).2
    (refinement_trans knob ((refinement_ok p q knob true hpq).1 rfl)
      ((refinement_ok q r knob true hqr).1 rfl))

theorem append_weaker_ok (out : alloc.vec.Vec policycompare.Knob) (p d : drivepolicy.Policies)
    (kind : model.DriveKind) (knob : policycompare.Knob) (r : alloc.vec.Vec policycompare.Knob)
    (h : policycompare.append_weaker out p d kind knob = ok r) :
    r.val = out.val ++ (if PolicyWeak p d kind knob then [knob] else []) := by
  classical
  cases knob <;> unfold policycompare.append_weaker at h <;> h5i_invert h
  all_goals try have ha := applies_ok _ _ _ hdefaultable
  all_goals try have hr := refinement_ok _ _ _ _ hb1
  all_goals try have hp := push_ok h
  all_goals simp_all [PolicyWeak, PolicyDefaultable, PolicyApplies]


theorem filter_cons_selected {α : Type} (P : α → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (x : α) (xs : List α) :
    (x :: xs).filter (fun a => decide (P a)) = (if P x then [x] else []) ++ xs.filter (fun a => decide (P a)) := by
  by_cases h : P x <;> simp [h]

theorem weaker_ok (p d : drivepolicy.Policies) (kind : model.DriveKind)
    (r : alloc.vec.Vec policycompare.Knob) (h : policycompare.weaker_than p d kind = ok r) :
    r.val = PolicyWeakerList p d kind := by
  classical
  unfold policycompare.weaker_than at h
  h5i_invert h
  have hp0 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout
  have hp1 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout1
  have hp2 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout2
  have hp3 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout3
  have hp4 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout4
  have hp5 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout5
  have hp6 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout6
  have hp7 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout7
  have hp8 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout8
  have hp9 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ h
  simp only [PolicyWeakerList, PolicyKnobOrder, filter_cons_selected, List.filter_nil]
  simp_all [alloc.vec.Vec.new, List.append_assoc]


end oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudPolicyCompare

import Verified.OxicloudPolicyMetadata
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result oxicloud_kernel oxicloud_kernel.SpecKernel
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
namespace oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudPolicyDefaults

theorem knob_ok (knob : policycompare.Knob) (kind : model.DriveKind)
    (r : Option policydefaults.KeyRejection) (h : policydefaults.reject_knob knob kind = ok r) :
    (r = none ↔ DefaultKnobAllowed knob kind) ∧
    (∀ reason, r = some reason → DefaultKnobRejection knob kind reason) := by
  cases knob <;> cases kind <;>
    simp_all [policydefaults.reject_knob, policycompare.knob_applies_to_kind,
      DefaultKnobAllowed, PolicyApplies, DefaultKnobRejection]
  all_goals subst_vars
  all_goals simp_all

theorem parsed_unique {raw : List U8} {a b : policycompare.Knob}
    (ha : PolicyKnobParsed raw a) (hb : PolicyKnobParsed raw b) : a = b := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all [PolicyKnobParsed, PolicyKnobWire, PolicyKnobNames]
  all_goals subst raw
  all_goals simp_all

theorem key_ok (raw : Slice U8) (kind : model.DriveKind)
    (r : Option policydefaults.KeyRejection) (h : policydefaults.reject_key raw kind = ok r) :
    (r = none ↔ DefaultKeyAllowed raw.val kind) ∧
    (∀ reason, r = some reason → DefaultKeyRejection raw.val kind reason) := by
  unfold policydefaults.reject_key at h
  h5i_invert h
  have hp := OxicloudPolicyMetadata.parsed_ok raw k hk
  have hd := knob_ok k kind r h
  refine ⟨⟨fun hn => ⟨k, hp, hd.1.mp hn⟩, ?_⟩, fun reason hr => ⟨k, hp, hd.2 reason hr⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨other, hp', ha⟩
  have he := parsed_unique hp hp'
  subst other
  exact hd.1.mpr ha

theorem validation_ok (kind : model.DriveKind) (isObject : Bool)
    (keys : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (r : policydefaults.Validation)
    (h : policydefaults.validate kind isObject keys = ok r) :
    DefaultsValidation kind isObject keys.val r := by
  unfold policydefaults.validate at h
  split at h
  · rename_i ho
    unfold policydefaults.validate_loop at h
    refine loop_ok _
      (fun i : Usize => ∀ j < i.val, ∀ raw, keys.val[j]? = some raw → DefaultKeyAllowed raw.val kind)
      (DefaultsValidation kind isObject keys.val)
      (fun i => keys.val.length - i.val) ?_ 0#usize r (by simp) h
    intro i result hp hr
    unfold policydefaults.validate_loop.body at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    · obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ := slice_index_ok hv
      have ha := (key_ok _ _ _ ho_1).1.mp rfl
      have hj := add_ok_val hi2
      refine ⟨?_, by scalar_tac⟩
      intro j hji raw heq
      by_cases hji' : j < i.val
      · exact hp j hji' raw heq
      · have hj' : j = i.val := by scalar_tac
        subst j
        have heq' : keys.val[i.val]? = some v := List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mpr ⟨hi, he⟩
        have : raw = v := by simp_all
        subst raw
        simpa [alloc.vec.Vec.deref] using ha
    · obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ := slice_index_ok hv
      have hb := (key_ok _ _ _ ho_1).2 reason rfl
      refine ⟨ho, ⟨v, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mpr ⟨hi, he⟩, ?_⟩, hp⟩
      simpa [alloc.vec.Vec.deref] using hb
    · refine ⟨ho, ?_⟩
      intro raw hm
      obtain ⟨j, hj, he⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.1 hm
      apply hp j (by scalar_tac) raw
      simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj, he]
  · cases r <;> simp_all [DefaultsValidation]

theorem rejection_excludes_allowed {raw : List U8} {kind : model.DriveKind}
    {reason : policydefaults.KeyRejection} (hb : DefaultKeyRejection raw kind reason) :
    ¬ DefaultKeyAllowed raw kind := by
  rintro ⟨other, ho, ha⟩
  obtain ⟨knob, hk, hr⟩ := hb
  have he := parsed_unique hk ho
  subst other
  cases reason <;> simp_all [DefaultKnobRejection, DefaultKnobAllowed, PolicyApplies]

theorem validation_exact (kind : model.DriveKind) (isObject : Bool)
    (keys : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (r : policydefaults.Validation)
    (h : policydefaults.validate kind isObject keys = ok r) :
    (r = .Valid ↔ isObject = true ∧ ∀ raw ∈ keys.val, DefaultKeyAllowed raw.val kind) := by
  have hd := validation_ok kind isObject keys r h
  cases r with
  | Valid => simpa [DefaultsValidation] using hd
  | NotObject => simp_all [DefaultsValidation]
  | Rejected index reason =>
    simp only [DefaultsValidation] at hd
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨raw, hm, hb⟩, _⟩ := hd
    constructor
    · intro hv
      cases hv
    · rintro ⟨_, hall⟩
      exact False.elim (rejection_excludes_allowed hb (hall raw (List.mem_of_getElem? hm)))

end oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudPolicyDefaults

  cases hc : p.max_public_link_days <;> simp_all

theorem refinement_ok (p q : drivepolicy.Policies) (knob : policycompare.Knob) (b : Bool)
    (h : policycompare.at_least_as_strict_on p q knob = ok b) :
    (b = true ↔ PolicyRefines p q knob) := by
  cases knob <;> simp_all [policycompare.at_least_as_strict_on, policycompare.knob_strictness,
    policycompare.knob_bool, policycompare.knob_value, PolicyRefines, PolicyBit, PolicyCapRefines]
  all_goals repeat' (split at h <;> simp_all)
  all_goals subst_vars
  all_goals simp_all

theorem cap_refines_refl (cap : Option U32) : PolicyCapRefines cap cap := by
  intro bound hb
  exact ⟨bound, hb, Nat.le_refl _⟩

theorem cap_refines_trans {a b c : Option U32}
    (hab : PolicyCapRefines a b) (hbc : PolicyCapRefines b c) : PolicyCapRefines a c := by
  intro bound hc
  obtain ⟨middle, hm, hmb⟩ := hbc bound hc
  obtain ⟨own, ho, hom⟩ := hab middle hm
  exact ⟨own, ho, hom.trans hmb⟩

theorem refinement_refl (p : drivepolicy.Policies) (knob : policycompare.Knob) : PolicyRefines p p knob := by
  cases knob <;> first | exact cap_refines_refl _ | exact fun h => h

theorem refinement_trans {p q r : drivepolicy.Policies} (knob : policycompare.Knob)
    (hpq : PolicyRefines p q knob) (hqr : PolicyRefines q r knob) : PolicyRefines p r knob := by
  cases knob <;> first
    | exact cap_refines_trans hpq hqr
    | exact fun h => hpq (hqr h)
    | exact fun h => hqr (hpq h)

theorem checked_refinement_transitive (p q r : drivepolicy.Policies) (knob : policycompare.Knob)
    (hpq : policycompare.at_least_as_strict_on p q knob = ok true)
    (hqr : policycompare.at_least_as_strict_on q r knob = ok true)
    (b : Bool) (hpr : policycompare.at_least_as_strict_on p r knob = ok b) : b = true := by
  exact (refinement_ok p r knob b hpr).2
    (refinement_trans knob ((refinement_ok p q knob true hpq).1 rfl)
      ((refinement_ok q r knob true hqr).1 rfl))

theorem append_weaker_ok (out : alloc.vec.Vec policycompare.Knob) (p d : drivepolicy.Policies)
    (kind : model.DriveKind) (knob : policycompare.Knob) (r : alloc.vec.Vec policycompare.Knob)
    (h : policycompare.append_weaker out p d kind knob = ok r) :
    r.val = out.val ++ (if PolicyWeak p d kind knob then [knob] else []) := by
  classical
  cases knob <;> unfold policycompare.append_weaker at h <;> h5i_invert h
  all_goals try have ha := applies_ok _ _ _ hdefaultable
  all_goals try have hr := refinement_ok _ _ _ _ hb1
  all_goals try have hp := push_ok h
  all_goals simp_all [PolicyWeak, PolicyDefaultable, PolicyApplies]


theorem filter_cons_selected {α : Type} (P : α → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (x : α) (xs : List α) :
    (x :: xs).filter (fun a => decide (P a)) = (if P x then [x] else []) ++ xs.filter (fun a => decide (P a)) := by
  by_cases h : P x <;> simp [h]

theorem weaker_ok (p d : drivepolicy.Policies) (kind : model.DriveKind)
    (r : alloc.vec.Vec policycompare.Knob) (h : policycompare.weaker_than p d kind = ok r) :
    r.val = PolicyWeakerList p d kind := by
  classical
  unfold policycompare.weaker_than at h
  h5i_invert h
  have hp0 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout
  have hp1 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout1
  have hp2 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout2
  have hp3 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout3
  have hp4 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout4
  have hp5 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout5
  have hp6 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout6
  have hp7 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout7
  have hp8 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout8
  have hp9 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ h
  simp only [PolicyWeakerList, PolicyKnobOrder, filter_cons_selected, List.filter_nil]
  simp_all [alloc.vec.Vec.new, List.append_assoc]

theorem parsed_ok (raw : Slice U8) (knob : policycompare.Knob)
    (h : policycompare.knob_from_bytes raw = ok knob) : PolicyKnobParsed raw.val knob := by
  unfold policycompare.knob_from_bytes at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals simp only [lift, Result.ok.injEq] at *
  all_goals subst_vars
  all_goals have he := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes.equal_ok _ _ _ hb
  all_goals try have he1 := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes.equal_ok _ _ _ hb1

  all_goals try have he3 := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes.equal_ok _ _ _ hb3
  all_goals try have he4 := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes.equal_ok _ _ _ hb4
  all_goals try have he5 := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes.equal_ok _ _ _ hb5
  all_goals try have he6 := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes.equal_ok _ _ _ hb6
  all_goals try have he7 := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes.equal_ok _ _ _ hb7
  all_goals try have he8 := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes.equal_ok _ _ _ hb8
  all_goals try have he9 := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes.equal_ok _ _ _ hb9
  all_goals simp_all [PolicyKnobParsed, PolicyKnobWire, PolicyKnobNames, Array.to_slice, Array.make]

theorem applies_bytes_ok (raw : Slice U8) (kind : model.DriveKind) (r : Bool)
    (h : policycompare.knob_applies_to_kind_bytes raw kind = ok r) :

theorem strictness_bytes_ok (raw : Slice U8)  (r : policycompare.Strictness)
